792-2403-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-2403-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1432-2645-3230-3430.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

Repeat.

When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-4985-5131-8095--202.description:

Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

1170-4779-5131-6289--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4779-5131-6289--202.description:

Resolve the artifact spell.

Repeat.

1643-2073-4779-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.

215-3443-3464.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-3464.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

338-2034-3330-3490.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1921-2034-2905.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Pestermite from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Pestermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Pestermite token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Pestermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Pestermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

2086-4050-6824.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Repeat.

527-1636-4050-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 2 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
527-1636-4050-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{U} plus an additional {X} equal to Sin's power minus 3.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {1}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Selvala.
Repeat.

440-1339-2811-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2811-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
When the Insect dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2498-3591-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2498-3591-4691.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat as desired.
Resolve all Necropotence abilities.

232-2034-4790-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
232-2034-4790-5149.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Priest of Urabrask token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Priest of Urabrask tokens.

3371-4893-4896-5299.notablePrerequisites: Codie does not have summoning sickness.
3371-4893-4896-5299.description:
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate High Alert by paying {W}{U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

659-2645-5231.easyPrerequisites: Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
659-2645-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Goblins.
659-2645-5231.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four Goblin tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Krenko.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1300-4050-4222-4459.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other Shrines.
1300-4050-4222-4459.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Go-Shintai triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Go-Shintai's ability.
Resolve the copy of Go-Shintai's ability, paying {1} to create at least four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirit tokens, adding {1}{U}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Repeat from step 2.
